stories.title: U.S. Treasury’s FinCEN Confirms Cyberattack, Takes Systems Offline After Unauthorized Access
stories.description: The U.S. Treasury Department’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) has taken some systems offline after confirming unauthorized access to a limited part of its network.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Drupal Core RCE, Idunno AntiCsrf and Optimizely Flaws Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA added three actively exploited flaws affecting Drupal Core, Idunno.AntiCsrf, and Optimizely Web Experimentation to its KEV Catalog.

stories.title: Beyond Holiday Scams: 5 Thanksgiving and Black Friday Cyberattacks Targeting Users and Businesses
stories.description: A Thanksgiving invitation, a Black Friday discount, or a holiday greeting may look harmless. But behind these familiar messages, cybercriminals are hiding threats that could expose corporate credentials, compromise endpoints, and put sensitive data at risk.

stories.title: Task Management App Todoist Hacked, Attackers Breach Production Systems
stories.description: Task management app Todoist said an attacker breached its production systems on November 23, 2026, and downloaded account records for about 6% of its users.

stories.title: Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
stories.description: Attackers are probing GeoServer instances for two high-severity flaws that can be chained with other bugs for unauthenticated RCE.

stories.title: ShinyHunters Claims Comeback, New Inception Group Rejects Alleged Ties
stories.description: An account tied to ShinyHunters announced the group’s return, as Okta spots possible links between Inception and ShinyHunters hackers.

stories.title: US Treasury’s FinCEN Disconnects Systems Following Cyber Incident
stories.description: FinCEN has extended deadlines for filers affected by the disruptions while it is investigating the incident.

stories.title: Ground Truth: CISO Matt Martin on Building a Real Security Program Without an Enterprise Budget
stories.description: Matthew Martin is Chief Information Security and Privacy Officer at Western Carolina University.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Two GeoServer Flaws as Researchers Warn of Unauthenticated RCE Chains
stories.description: Attackers are exploiting two newly patched GeoServer flaws that could enable file disclosure and authorization bypass without authentication.

stories.title: U.S. Treasury's Financial Crimes Agency Takes Some Systems Offline After Cyber Intrusion
stories.description: U.S. Treasury's FinCEN confirms unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems and takes some systems offline as a precaution.

stories.title: Credential Remediation Is Slow When You Don’t Know What Will Break
stories.description: GitGuardian finds 64% of valid secrets discovered in 2022 still worked in January 2026, while validity-only triage misses 46% of critical secrets.
